## berth org migrate

move an org to a registered host (rehearsal, then an announced switch), or stream it to berth over ssh

### Synopsis

move an org to a registered host (rehearsal, then an announced switch), or stream it to berth over ssh

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_org_migrate/

```
berth org migrate <org>[@host] <host> [--as name] [--yes|--no-switch] | <org> <[user@]host> [--as name] [--remote-dir dir] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth org migrate acme box1
  berth org migrate acme@box1 local --yes
  berth org migrate acme ops@box.example # ccenv's: to berth over ssh
```
